services.title: What Linting does
services.subtitle: Four ways to work together, on the same footing: clean code, frequent releases and direct communication.

apps.title: Custom web and mobile apps
apps.description: Systems, dashboards and Android and iOS apps built around your process, with front end, API and database.
points: Web with React, Next.js, Vue and Nuxt
APIs in Node.js or .NET on PostgreSQL

ai.title: AI agents and MCP integrations
ai.description: We connect Claude and other AI to your business's tools, so they can look up data and get real work done, not just answer questions.
points: MCP servers for your systems, spreadsheets and internal APIs
Claude-powered agents that automate routine work
The same experience that built AgentBox and Hatch

sites.title: Landing pages and websites
sites.description: Fast, responsive, SEO-ready pages to present your company or launch a product.
points: Nuxt, Next.js or Astro with Tailwind CSS
Portuguese and English when you need both

mvp.title: Product and MVP development
mvp.description: From idea to a first version in production: a lean scope, weekly releases and a product you can put in customers' hands.
points: Sign-in, payments and an admin dashboard
Priority on what validates the idea
A codebase ready to grow after launch

products.title: Products by Linting
products.subtitle: Tools Linting built and uses every day. They're proof that we know AI in practice.

agentbox.tagline: Isolated machines for AI coding agents, on your own computer.
agentbox.description: Each agent (Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode) gets a Linux machine of its own, with its own desktop, browser and branch. A lead chat creates the agents, briefs them and tells you when they're done.
points: Several agents on one project, never colliding on ports, databases or files
Each agent's desktop and browser, to watch or take over
Screenshots, recordings and test reports as proof of the work
agentbox.imageAlt: A project's lead chat in AgentBox, directing four agents

hatch.tagline: Publish and share pages with a link.
hatch.description: Publish HTML from the dashboard or the terminal and share it with a private, public or expiring link. With its MCP server, your AI agents can publish too.
points: Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and VS Code
Every publish is a new version; nothing gets lost
Private, public, permanent or expiring links

founder.title: Who's behind it
founder.name: Leandro Ciric
founder.bio: Full-stack developer since 2021, with time at Stefanini, 7waves and Consorciocred. Works with React, Vue, React Native, Node.js and .NET, and built AgentBox and Hatch to put AI agents to real work.
founder.origin: "lint" was my nickname before I ever programmed. When I started writing code, the company became "linting".
